messages:
dana: Quick sync - long-term routing policy doc needs clearer launch gates and tenant migration primitives. Posting draft checklist here for ops/product feedback.

frank: thanks. can we separate policy goals from migration mechanics? i want a clear section on SLA targets vs what platform will enforce.

ravi: agree. for multi-region, add a rule: no tenant region lock until network egress latency < 80ms to nearest region replica.

zoe: customer ask: large marketplace wants hard isolation lanes for high-compliance tenants. they offered to pay for reserved capacity. how do we model billing/commit?

dana: propose policy primitives: lane_type enum (shared, isolated-soft, isolated-hard), billing_model (on-demand, reserved-monthly), migration_window (rolling, immediate), fallback_policy (degraded->variant->abort).

ops-bot: alert: load-test-cluster-3 reached 85% GPU mem, observed during yesterday's throughput run.

frank: migration mechanics idea: staged redeploy + prefix-warm strategy. steps: 1) allocate target slice 2) run shadow traffic 3) warm KV cache with traced prefixes 4) small % live traffic 5) ramp. each step has objective checks.

ravi: objective checks list: p50/p95/p99 latency delta thresholds, error-rate delta, token-cost delta, isolation-noise metric, region-failover-resilience test.

zoe: for billing, add "cost-protection" flag that guarantees monthly cap with overage alerts and automated throttles if exceeded. customers can opt-in to soft or hard throttles.

frank: we need launch gates defined as PASS/FAIL with owners:
- perf PASS: p99 <= 400ms on isolated-hard at nominal load (eng-runtime)
- isolation PASS: noise_metric <= 0.2% (eng-security)
- ops PASS: rollout automation tested end-to-end (eng-sre)
- billing PASS: invoicing flow validated with finance (finance/product)

ravi: also include an operational kill-switch: route all affected tenants to a fallback model family in the same region. document the expected client impact in SLO terms.

dana: migration teardown: tenant revert path must complete within 30m for <10k rps tenant, and within 2h for larger. include a step-by-step revert script in runbook.

zoe: note on private deployments: KMS keys and audit logs must be explicit in migration checklist. customers won't migrate otherwise.

frank: draft rollout cadence: alpha customers (2 tenants) -> beta cohort (10 tenants) -> general availability. each phase gated by telemetry review. recommend 6 week beta window.

ops-bot: scheduled: runbook smoke test -> 2025-07-20T09:00Z

dana: next action items: frank to write objective gate definitions, ravi to add region-latency guard, zoe to propose billing contract templates, eng-sre to schedule smoke tests. will collate into a launch PR. comments due COB next Tue.
